slice: KAI Visual Engine — validated Core→renderer vertical slice
rule: KAI is the system; OpenGhost is a source of mechanisms. KAI remains the single control plane and the single security/policy authority. The slice is exactly: KAI Core -> structured visual intent -> validator -> KAI Visual Engine -> OpenGhost-derived mechanism -> real KAI UI.
licenceBoundary: OpenGhost's engine is MIT; its name, ghost identity, artwork, animations and visual design are excluded. NOTHING was imported from styles.css, images/**, icons, cursor.png, the splash modules or any OpenGhost branding. The adapted mechanism draws KAI's own palette through the app's existing CSS vars.

tagLegend.UNIT PROVEN: exercised by an automated test or a typecheck in this repo
tagLegend.INTEGRATION PROVEN: two real components proven to talk (live HTTP or live DOM), not the full chain
tagLegend.END-TO-END PROVEN: the whole seam exercised in the REAL packaged product (kai.exe + its Core + its WebView2 renderer), captured live
tagLegend.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: could not be reached for a reason outside this repo

artifactIdentity.sourceCheckReason: no core/src beside the running artifact (a shipped bundle carries compiled output only); source equality cannot be recomputed here

claims.claim: The KAI-owned visual-intent contract, dialect parser and validator exist in Core and refuse (never repair) malformed/adversarial input, with hard bounds (64 nodes / 128 edges / 80-char labels / 20k source).
claims.evidence: core/src/visual/spec.ts; core/tests/visual.test.ts — 15 tests, all pass (part of the core suite: 755 tests, 742 pass, 0 fail, 13 skipped)
claims.detail: Rejections carry a named code+reason: UNSAFE_NODE_LABEL, SELF_LOOP, BAD_EDGE_ENDPOINT, BAD_NODE_ID, DUPLICATE_NODE, TOO_MANY_NODES, UNSUPPORTED_KIND, SOURCE_TOO_LARGE, BAD_KIND, EMPTY.

claims.claim: Core exposes the seam over HTTP: POST /visual/compile (raw text -> validated intent) and POST /visual/validate (structured intent -> checked). A refusal is a rich 400 {error,reason,code,rejected}.
claims.evidence: core/src/api/routes.ts (compileVisualHandler, validateVisualHandler); live HTTP in docs/evidence/visual-live.json .raw
claims.detail: Live: valid source -> 200 {intent}; 'A[<script>alert(1)</script>] --> B' -> 400 UNSAFE_NODE_LABEL; 'sequenceDiagram...' -> 400 UNSUPPORTED_KIND; 'A --> A' -> 400 SELF_LOOP.

claims.claim: app/src/visual/engine.ts compiles clean after the beginAt fix (the Item.beginAt field is now set at build time as started + delay*1000 and consumed by step() as `now < item.beginAt`).
claims.detail: Also fixed: removed unused CYAN/svgRoot, cast path to SVGPathElement for getTotalLength, removed the stray `void back;`, converted the three delay: literals to beginAt.

claims.claim: The layered flow layout is pure and deterministic, and the client-side guardIntent mirror refuses the same classes of malformed intent as Core.
claims.evidence: app/tests/visual.test.ts — 15 tests; app suite 133 tests, 133 pass (was 118/118; +15)
claims.detail: Layout: finite geometry, TD rank order, LR advance, determinism, label wrapping. Guard: NOT_AN_OBJECT, BAD_KIND, BAD_DIRECTION, EMPTY, UNSAFE_NODE_LABEL, BAD_EDGE_ENDPOINT, SELF_LOOP, DUPLICATE_NODE, TOO_MANY_NODES.

claims.detail: window.__kaiVisual.compile(valid flow) -> {ok:true,via:'core',receipt:{nodes:7,edges:6,width:289,height:486}}. Live DOM: 7 .kai-visual-node, 6 .kai-visual-edge, labels ['Model output','Core: parse','Validator','KAI Visual Engine','400 rejection','SVG renderer','Real KAI UI'].

claims.claim: The rendered result was visually inspected: a real node-and-edge flow is on screen.
claims.detail: vision description: dark background; 'Model output' box -> blue arrow -> 'Core: parse' box -> 'Validator' diamond -> two labelled branches ('accept' -> 'KAI Visual Engine', 'refuse' -> '400 rejection'); a scrollbar is present (the 486px diagram is taller than the 320px window and the host scrolls). White text, light-grey rounded node borders, bright-blue arrows.

claims.claim: The validator is a real security boundary: adversarial model text cannot reach the renderer unvalidated.
claims.detail: Raw HTTP 400 payload: {"error":true,"reason":"\"nodes[0].label\" must not contain markup or control characters; got \"<script>alert(1)</script>\"","code":"UNSAFE_NODE_LABEL","rejected":true}. The same source through the real host returns {ok:false,via:'core',code:'UNSAFE_NODE_LABEL'}. A malformed STRUCTURED intent handed straight to the engine (window.__kaiVisual.render) is refused by the client-side guard with UNSAFE_NODE_LABEL — the renderer re-checks even a payload that bypassed Core. The post-refusal screenshot is byte-identical to the rendered one (md5 9aff5bde610b1ec59d92073cded9cd39): the refusal drew nothing, leaving the screen unchanged.

notProven.claim: A Core-driven automatic path (a real chat/model turn emits a visual intent that auto-renders).
notProven.detail: The seam is proven by driving the product's own host handle. No model turn is wired to call visualCompile yet, and no prompt instructs a model to emit the dialect.
Exactly one kind (flow) with three node shapes (box/round/diamond). OpenGhost's other 42 kinds are NOT ported.

No island view was added (scope discipline). The host is a fixed panel over the island and reveal() expands to the existing 'overview' view — a side effect on the island's displayed view, not a bespoke view.
The engine is DOM-dependent and is proven live; its animation is not unit-tested. Layout + guard are unit-tested.
